topic: Large Language Models and the Transformer Architecture
target_audience: University students with a basic background in computer science

sections.title: Prerequisites: The Vector Space Concept
lecture_lines: Words are converted into numerical vectors.
animations: Fade in a grid labeled 'Vector Space' in #FFFFFF color with a decorative [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/cat.png].
Highlight a single vector 'v' in #FF00FF color.
Animate 'v' adding to another vector 'u' to form 'v+u' in #00FFFF color alongside a [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/dog.svg].

sections.title: The Transformer Core: Self-Attention Mechanism
animations: Display the self-attention formula in #FFFFFF color alongside [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/animal.svg].
Flash Query (Q), Key (K), and Value (V) matrices in #FFD700.
Animate the dot product QK^T heatmap in #FF0000.

sections.title: Scaling Up: From Transformer to LLM
animations: Pulse a layer [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/blocks.svg] to illustrate expanding model depth in #00FF00.
Animate weights updating across the [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/blocks.svg] layers in #FF4500.

sections.title: Application: The Probabilistic Prediction Engine
animations: Display a probability distribution over vocabulary in #FFFFFF using the cat icon [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/cat.png].
Animate picking a token from the tail of distribution in #FFFF00.
Transition to the next generated word in #800080 color using the car icon [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/car.png].
